comparison.objective: Rack fifteen pool balls tightly on the foot spot and remove the triangle without disturbing them.
comparison.physical_skill: Collective rigid-body packing, bimanual rack manipulation, compression, and clearance-sensitive lift-off.
comparison.success_condition: All 30 neighboring pairs within 0.5 mm, head ball within 5 mm of the spot, correct pack orientation, rack removed, balls still, and hands clear; disturbance during removal can latch failure.
comparison.reason: It shares multi-object contact management and careful tool removal, but tests dense packing rather than selective aperture passage, bridge release, and recovery of one constituent while retaining another.
